n9956ae24628.s: Which one of the following statements about the Disha Bill is correct?
o: It received Presidential assent and came into force in 2019.
It was enacted by Parliament and amended only the CrPC.
It was withdrawn after receiving Presidential assent.
n9956ae24628.x: The Disha Bill never received Presidential assent; the IPC and CrPC it sought to amend were replaced by the BNS and BNSS from 1 July 2024.

nindian-society-35-29.s:
Consider the following statements about Mission Vatsalya:
1. It covers child protection.
2. It includes foster care.
3. It provides LPG connections in women's names.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-35-29.x: Mission Vatsalya covers child protection, foster care and juvenile justice homes. LPG connections in women's names come under Ujjwala.

na5448478800.s: One Stop Centre (Sakhi) provides which services under one roof?
o: Medical, legal, counselling and shelter support
na5448478800.x: One Stop Centre provides medical, legal, counselling and shelter support under one roof and is funded from the Nirbhaya Fund.

n8475bddafd2.s: Which of the following is NOT an objective of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao?
o: Ensuring survival, protection and education of the girl child
Arresting the decline in Child Sex Ratio
n8475bddafd2.x: BBBP focuses on the Child Sex Ratio, preventing gender-biased sex selection and the survival, protection and education of girls; legal assistance is not its stated objective.

n57ba529c930.s: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (2015), introduced under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, is:
o: A small-savings account for a girl below 10 years
A post-birth grant for girls of BPL families
A pension scheme for women above 60 years
A vocational training scheme for adolescent girls
n57ba529c930.x: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, introduced in 2015 under BBBP, is a small-savings account for girls below 10 years, mainly for education and marriage.

n1b086159051.s: Which one of the following is correctly associated with the Dhanalakshmi scheme?
o: 1997 – Post-birth grant and scholarships for BPL girls
2008 – Conditional cash transfer for the girl child
n1b086159051.x: Dhanalakshmi (2008) was a conditional cash transfer linked to birth registration, immunisation, schooling and delaying marriage beyond 18.

nd91069c5242.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: IGMSY – Free antenatal check-up on the ninth of every month
PMMVY – Partial wage-loss compensation for the first living child
PMSMA – Institutional-delivery cash assistance under NHM
nd91069c5242.x: PMMVY gives partial wage-loss compensation; IGMSY was the pilot maternity benefit, PMSMA gives ninth-of-month antenatal check-ups and JSY supports institutional delivery.

ne75d82b786b.s: Which of the following is NOT a form of untouchability?
o: The two-tumbler system in tea shops
ne75d82b786b.x: Temple-entry denial, residential segregation and the two-tumbler system are forms of untouchability; reservation of seats is a protective measure, not such a practice.

naedea5e572b.s: In the context of untouchability, "structural violence" refers to:
naedea5e572b.x: Structural violence, a concept associated with Johan Galtung, is harm built into social structures.

ne7ba0c7d940.s: Which one of the following correctly matches the Articles with the lists they deal with?
ne7ba0c7d940.x: Article 341 concerns the list of Scheduled Castes, Article 342 the Scheduled Tribes and Article 342A the socially and educationally backward classes.

nfc6cf489254.s: Which one of the following is correct about the list of Scheduled Castes of a State?
o: The Governor notifies it with the State Legislature's approval.
The State Legislature notifies it by resolution.
The President notifies it after consulting the Governor.
The National Commission for Scheduled Castes notifies it by order.
nfc6cf489254.x: Under Article 341, the President specifies the Scheduled Castes of a State after consulting the Governor; later inclusion or exclusion can be made only by Parliament by law.

n425acc2e4ff.s: In Chinthada Anand v. State of Andhra Pradesh, the Supreme Court held that a Scheduled Caste person who converts to Christianity:
o: Can claim SC status on the State Government's recommendation alone
Cannot claim SC status merely on the basis of earlier caste identity
Retains SC status because religion is irrelevant to the SC list
n425acc2e4ff.x: A Christian convert cannot claim SC status merely on earlier caste identity; reconversion requires proof of original SC status, bona fide reconversion and acceptance by the community.

nindian-society-40-6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Manual Scavengers Act, 2013?
o: It prohibits hazardous manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks.
It permits hazardous manual cleaning when done by private contractors.
It provides for rehabilitation of manual scavengers with alternative livelihoods.
nindian-society-40-6.x: The 2013 Act bans hazardous manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks by anyone, including private contractors, and requires mechanisation and rehabilitation.

nindian-society-42-10.s: The Bhikhu Ramji Idate Commission led directly to which scheme?
nindian-society-42-10.x: The Idate Commission surveyed denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes and led to the SEED scheme for their economic empowerment.

nindian-society-42-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bhikhu Ramji Idate Commission – Socio-economic status of Muslims
Justice K.G. Balakrishnan Commission – SC status for certain converted Dalits
Rajiv Gauba Committee – Survey of DNTs, NTs and SNTs
Justice Rajindar Sachar Committee – Most backward SC sub-castes
nindian-society-42-13.x: The Balakrishnan Commission examined SC status for converted Dalits; Idate surveyed DNTs, NTs and SNTs, Gauba the most backward SC sub-castes and Sachar the Muslim community.

nindian-society-50-3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Protection of Civil Rights Act?
o: It prescribes penalties for practising untouchability.
It was renamed in 1976 from the Untouchability (Offences) Act.
It came into force on 1 June 1955.
It came into force on 30 January 1990.
nindian-society-50-3.x: The Act came into force on 1 June 1955; 30 January 1990 is the commencement date of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

nef19e51b46f.s: Which one of the following is correct under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and Rules?
o: Police investigation must ordinarily be completed within 60 days.
The Act was enacted in 1995 and the Rules framed in 1989.
Vigilance and monitoring committees exist only at the national level.
Police investigation must ordinarily be completed within 90 days.
nef19e51b46f.x: The investigation is to be completed within 60 days; the Act dates from 1989 and the Rules from 1995, with State and district vigilance and monitoring committees.

n75d1fbaeca0.s: Which combination is identified as the principal means of abolishing untouchability?
n75d1fbaeca0.x: Untouchability can be addressed through legislation, education and public awareness.

nd7227354216.s: Manual scavenging has been described as the:
o: Oldest surviving form of bonded labour
Worst surviving form of child labour
Last surviving form of forced labour
nd7227354216.x: Manual scavenging is described as the “worst surviving symbol of untouchability.”

nb20d3292ebf.s: Which of the following pairs (Work – Author) is correctly matched?
nb20d3292ebf.x: Jatimimamsa is by Sree Narayana Guru; Gabbilam is by Gurram Jashuva, Annihilation of Caste by B.R. Ambedkar and Gulamgiri by Jyotiba Phule.

nindian-society-42-12.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Rajiv Gauba Committee?
o: It was set up by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs to examine ST status for the Madigas.
It was a Cabinet Secretary panel constituted in 2024.
It examined equitable mechanisms for the most backward SC sub-castes.
It concerned SC sub-castes such as the Madigas.
nindian-society-42-12.x: The Gauba panel was a 2024 Cabinet Secretary panel on the most backward SC sub-castes such as the Madigas; it was not a Tribal Affairs body and did not examine ST status.

n7c995db7519.s: Which one of the following is correct about Special Courts under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act?
o: They are set up by the Supreme Court without consulting the State judiciary.
They are set up in each district with the concurrence of the High Court Chief Justice.
Exclusive Special Courts were part of the original 1989 Act.
Trials under the Act are held only by ordinary Magistrates.
n7c995db7519.x: Special Courts are set up in each district with the concurrence of the Chief Justice of the High Court; Exclusive Special Courts were added by the 2015 amendment.

nindian-society-50-5.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act is correctly matched?
nindian-society-50-5.x: The Act was passed in 1989 and came into force on 30 January 1990; it was amended on 20 August 2018, adding Section 18A.

n5fbc5998490.s: Which Ministry is the nodal Ministry at the Union level for the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
n5fbc5998490.x: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is the nodal ministry, with the Ministry of Home Affairs also associated with implementation.

n187454b4d2a.s: The 2015 amendment to the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act introduced a new chapter on:
n187454b4d2a.x: The 2015 amendment introduced a new chapter on the rights of victims and witnesses.

n6cd02e3847d.s: Under the 2015 amendment to the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, economic boycott and social boycott were:
o: Left to the Protection of Civil Rights Act
n6cd02e3847d.x: The 2015 amendment defined economic and social boycott and made them offences amounting to atrocities.

n82dab0359a1.s: Which one of the following is correct about the implementation of the Mandal Commission recommendations?
o: Implemented by the V.P. Singh Government in 1993; posts reserved in 1995
Implemented by the Morarji Desai Government in 1979; posts reserved in 1980
Implemented by the Rajiv Gandhi Government in 1989; posts reserved in 1990
Implemented by the V.P. Singh Government in 1990; 27 per cent posts reserved in 1993
n82dab0359a1.x: The V.P. Singh Government implemented the Mandal recommendations in 1990, and 27 per cent of Central civil posts were reserved for OBCs in 1993.

nindian-society-42-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Kaka Kalelkar Commission – 27% reservation for OBCs
B.P. Mandal Commission – Foundation for the PESA Act, 1996
Justice G. Rohini Commission – Sub-categorisation within the OBC Central List
Bhuria Committee – First Backward Classes Commission
nindian-society-42-4.x: The Rohini Commission studied OBC sub-categorisation; Kalelkar was the First Backward Classes Commission, Mandal recommended 27% for OBCs and Bhuria laid the basis for PESA.

o: Sub-categorisation within the Central OBC List
27% reservation for OBCs based on 11 indicators
nindian-society-42-30.x: Kalelkar recommended a caste-based census and reservations; sub-categorisation was Rohini's task, 27% and 11 indicators Mandal's, and 15% for minorities Ranganath Misra's.

n80562f51aee.s: The OBC creamy-layer criteria in the DoPT Office Memorandum of September 1993 were based on the report of the:
n80562f51aee.x: The creamy-layer criteria were framed through the DoPT Office Memorandum of September 1993, based on the Justice R.N. Prasad Expert Committee.

nindian-society-42-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the B.P. Mandal Commission?
o: It was the second Backward Classes Commission.
It was constituted by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
nindian-society-42-2.x: The Mandal Commission was set up through the Ministry of Home Affairs, not Social Justice and Empowerment; it identified 3,743 backward castes and recommended 27% for OBCs.

ne0f4389b0b9.s: The first principle of Nehru's Panchsheel for tribal development is to:
o: Impose a uniform administration on all tribal areas
Develop tribal people along the lines of their own genius
Measure progress by the money spent
Assimilate tribal people rapidly into mainstream culture
ne0f4389b0b9.x: The first principle is to develop tribal people along their own genius, respecting their distinct capacities and culture.

n7296cb37f2e.s: The Forest Rights Act, 2006 sought to undo the historical injustice done to:
n7296cb37f2e.x: The Act recognises forest rights of Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers, with the stated objective of undoing historical injustice to forest dwellers.

nindian-society-40-5.s:
Consider the following statements about the Forest Rights Act, 2006:
1. It recognises individual and community forest rights.
2. These rights are recognised for forest-dwelling Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-40-5.x: Both are correct: the Act recognises individual and community forest rights of forest-dwelling STs and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers.

nindian-society-50-9.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Forest Rights Act is correctly matched?
o: Rights vested – Individual and community forest rights
nindian-society-50-9.x: The FRA was passed in 2006, came into force on 31 December 2007, had its rules notified on 1 January 2008, and vests individual and community forest rights.

nindian-society-35-25.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Sickle Cell Elimination Mission:
1. It is associated with the Ministries of Health & Family Welfare and Tribal Affairs.
2. It focuses on screening tribal populations.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-35-25.x: Both are correct: the Mission is run by Health & Family Welfare with Tribal Affairs and focuses on screening tribal populations.

nindian-society-37-12.s:
Consider the following statements about PM-AJAY:
1. Its portal supports planning and monitoring of works in SC-majority Adarsh Grams.
2. It includes fund convergence.
3. It is a portal for tribal artisans to sell forest produce.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-37-12.x: 1 and 2 are correct: PM-AJAY plans, pools funds for and monitors works in SC-majority Adarsh Grams. 3 is wrong; the tribal artisans' marketplace is TRIFED/Tribes India.

n04b44a90590.s: Which of the following contributed to tribal indebtedness and land alienation during colonial rule?
n04b44a90590.x: Colonial moneylenders and revenue farmers contributed to indebtedness and land alienation, while restrictive forest laws cut tribals off from their habitats.

nindian-society-35-12.s:
Consider the following statements about PM-JANMAN:
1. It is intended for Scheduled Tribes.
2. It stands for PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan.
3. Its interventions include housing, roads, clean water and electrification.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-35-12.x: All three are correct: PM-JANMAN (PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan) is for STs, especially PVTGs, with housing, roads, water and electricity as key interventions.

nb6e72bc48ab.s: Which one of the following correctly states the Andhra Pradesh figures for Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Areas?
o: STs 27.39 lakh (5.53% of the State); Scheduled Areas 10.15% of the State
STs 34 lakh (5.53% of the State); Scheduled Areas 27.39% of the State
STs 27.39 lakh (10.15% of the State); Scheduled Areas 5.53% of the State
STs 20 lakh (9% of the State); Scheduled Areas 10.15% of the State
nb6e72bc48ab.x: STs in Andhra Pradesh number 27.39 lakh, 5.53 per cent of the population, while Scheduled Areas cover 10.15 per cent of the State.

n64c8b19396a.s: Which of the following pairs (Approach – Idea) relating to tribal policy is correctly matched?
o: Isolation – Development while retaining tribal identity
Assimilation – Tribes kept apart to protect their culture
Integration – Development while retaining tribal identity
Integration – Tribes treated as 'backward Hindus' and absorbed
n64c8b19396a.x: Integration combines development with retention of identity; isolation keeps tribes apart to protect their culture, and assimilation absorbs them as 'backward Hindus'.

nindian-society-37-13.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NAMASTE portal?
o: It is associated with the Urban Affairs sector and Social Justice & Empowerment.
It conducts online CBT registration and seat allotment for SC students.
It digitally profiles sewer and septic-tank workers.
It supports health-insurance linkage and PPE verification.
nindian-society-37-13.x: Online CBT registration and seat allotment for SC students is done by the SHRESHTA portal; NAMASTE profiles sewer and septic-tank workers and links them to insurance and PPE.

nfee9f21b1ae.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four core principles of the UNCRC?
o: Right to life, survival and development
nfee9f21b1ae.x: The four core principles are non-discrimination, best interests of the child, life-survival-development and respect for the child's views; free secondary education is not one of them.

n8e7abd63c3b.s: Which one of the following is NOT one of the four broad categories of rights under the UNCRC?
n8e7abd63c3b.x: The four categories are survival, development, protection and participation; education is not listed as a separate category.

n3270d8d5f93.s:
Which of the following are associated with monitoring and grievance redressal under the RTE Act?
1. National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
2. State Commissions for Protection of Child Rights
3. School Management Committees as statutory child-rights commissions
n3270d8d5f93.x: NCPCR and SCPCRs monitor and redress grievances under the RTE Act; School Management Committees are school-level bodies, not statutory child-rights commissions.

n513d9f9f814.s:
Samagra Shiksha (2018) merged which of the following?
1. Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
2. Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan
3. Teacher Education
n513d9f9f814.x: Samagra Shiksha merged SSA, RMSA and Teacher Education into an integrated school education scheme.

n97fd3eb159d.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four priority areas of the National Policy for Children, 2013?
n97fd3eb159d.x: The four priority areas are survival, health and nutrition; education and development; protection; and participation. Vocational employment is not one of them.

n51f8911940c.s: The Draft National Policy on Child Protection requires which of the following in all organisations?
o: A child-rights audit by the NCPCR
n51f8911940c.x: The Draft National Policy on Child Protection requires a zero-tolerance code of conduct in all organisations.

nindian-society-49-5.s: The 2021 amendment to the Juvenile Justice Act empowered which authority to issue adoption orders?
o: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
State Commissions for Protection of Child Rights
nindian-society-49-5.x: The 2021 amendment (in force from 2022) gave District Magistrates the power to issue adoption orders in place of courts.

nb5690cc9703.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the POCSO Act is correctly matched?
o: Sections 29–30 – Burden of proof on the accused
Section 19 – Burden of proof on the accused
nb5690cc9703.x: Sections 29–30 place the burden of proof on the accused; Section 19 concerns mandatory reporting and Section 22 false complaints.

nindian-society-40-12.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the POCSO Act, 2012?
o: It provides for child-friendly special courts.
It includes capital punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
It excludes stringent punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
nindian-society-40-12.x: POCSO (amended 2019) has stringent punishment, including death, for aggravated penetrative sexual assault; it also has special courts and mandatory reporting.

nindian-society-49-6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the RTE Act?
o: It mandates a 20% quota in private unaided schools for disadvantaged groups.
It came into force on 1 April 2010.
It mandates a 25% quota in private unaided schools for disadvantaged groups.
It enforces Article 21A for children aged 6–14.
nindian-society-49-6.x: The RTE Act reserves 25%, not 20%, of seats in private unaided schools for disadvantaged children; it came into force on 1 April 2010.

nindian-society-49-10.s:
Consider the following statements about the POCSO Act:
1. Its 2019 amendment added capital punishment for aggravated penetrative assault.
2. It came into force on 14 November 2012.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-49-10.x: Both are correct: POCSO came into force on 14 November 2012 (Children's Day), and the 2019 amendment added the death penalty for aggravated penetrative assault.

nindian-society-43-18.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Gurupadaswamy Committee?
o: It was associated with the Ministry of Labour.
It recommended regulating hazardous child labour and banning all other forms.
It recognised that child labour is tied to poverty.
Its recommendations led to the 1986 Child Labour Act.
nindian-society-43-18.x: The Committee recommended banning hazardous child labour and regulating other forms, the reverse of the statement; that approach led to the 1986 Act.

nindian-society-40-14.s:
Consider the following statements about the Child and Adolescent Labour Act, as amended in 2016:
1. It prohibits employing children below 14 in all occupations, except helping in family enterprises after school hours.
2. It prohibits employing adolescents aged 14–18 in hazardous occupations and processes.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-40-14.x: Both are correct: the 2016 amendment bans children under 14 from all occupations except family-enterprise help after school, and bars adolescents from hazardous work.

n3fb619da0e0.s: After the IPC was replaced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita from 1 July 2024, the POCSO Act:
o: Was subsumed entirely into the BNS
Continues as a separate special law
Was merged with the Juvenile Justice Act
n3fb619da0e0.x: The IPC was replaced by the BNS from 1 July 2024, but POCSO continues as a separate special law.

n542cfd68289.x: ILO Convention No. 182 deals with the Worst Forms of Child Labour; Convention No. 138 deals with the Minimum Age for Employment.

nindian-society-43-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Jaya Jaitly Task Force?
o: It linked its recommendation with lowering MMR and IMR.
It recommended raising women's minimum marriage age from 18 to 20 years.
It recommended raising women's minimum marriage age from 18 to 21 years.
nindian-society-43-2.x: The Task Force recommended raising women's minimum marriage age from 18 to 21, not 20, to bring down MMR and IMR.
